assertions.assertion: Blue Summit Plan denied CPT 93271 (Cardiac Event Monitoring)
CPT 93271 corresponds to Cardiac Event Monitoring
The denial is based on Reason Code PR-204
PR-204 indicates that this specific service is not covered under the member's current benefit plan
The patient presents with recurrent episodes of palpitations and exertional dyspnea, raising concern for paroxysmal atrial fibrillation in the setting of known nonrheumatic mitral valve insufficiency
A cardiac event monitor is ordered to capture rhythm data during symptomatic episodes to guide further management and assess the burden of arrhythmia
